purpose: Public-key references of the signers whose Ed25519 signature over StegOS's NODE_LEDGER_OPENED generation record (domain stegverse.node-ledger-opened-signature/v1) llm_adapter.endpoint_ledger_anchor accepts (LC-KV-16).
custody: TV/TVC. Keys are generated and held by TV/TVC custody only; bots and this repository never hold key material. A reference is added here only by an admitted change carrying TV/TVC's publication receipt.
state: NONE_PUBLISHED: every EPHEMERAL anchor is FAIL_CLOSED NODE_LEDGER_OPENED_SIGNER_NOT_PUBLISHED until one is published. PERMANENT, KV, SKAP_VAULT and GATEWAY anchors do not use this file.
